X01.classification: explicit Q24 Web replacement where native order/eligibility unverified
X01.trigger: One attributed hostile death, exactly once. At fatal commit snapshot victim XY/owner/nativeHero/level/summoned/illusion plus actual fatal damage source and owner.
excludedDeaths: timed life expiry without damage source
non-hero structure with no object-enabled attack channel
X01.killer: Use actual fatal packet source owner, not last ordinary attacker or the local Tower_ALL reward mapping in anyUnitDEAT. Summoned/dummy/illusion source does not by itself halve XP.
X01.deathCallbackOrder: Resolve XP transaction and synchronous level events before original anyUnitDEAT; preserve its internal order. Snapshot before immediate revival/removal.
X01.replay: One death transaction identity; persist committed status so load/repeated delivery cannot reaward.

X02.classification: source range/global switches plus explicit Q24 candidate/rounding/default choices
X02.geometry: 2D center squared distance <=2560000 from dying unit
candidates: owner is killer owner or friendly to killer owner
X02.otherDisables: PauseUnit/stun/transform does not implicitly suspend XP. No map SuspendHeroXP call was found.
X02.denominator: All candidate heroes, including level30 and creep-factor0; excludes dead/out-of-range/constructing/XP-suspended heroes.
X02.base: B02.H(actual hero level) for native hero victims, otherwise B02.N(victim unit level); no wave-index substitute or level30 clamp for ordinary victims.
X02.rounding: For nonmax recipient floor(base * summonFactor * recipientCreepFactor / candidateCount) once using exact rational arithmetic; max recipient receives0. No remainder redistribution.
X02.recipientSnapshot: Snapshot candidate set and each recipient level/factor/award once per death; commit in creation order. Later deaths take fresh snapshot.
X02.zeroCandidates: No award and no global fallback.

X03.classification: preserve five verified script amounts; explicit native-integration rules
X03.target: Valid alive native hero; preserve ability target eligibility. Script level==30 guard returns before AddHeroXP.
X03.scriptVariableAward: D(L): execute original binary64 order, no intermediate floor, final math.floor; not B02 threshold delta.

X04.classification: preserve script gate and order; explicit Q24 native level-transition/strip semantics
X04.positiveAward: newXP=min(oldXP+award,T30); cross levels ascending, add corresponding natural level growth and unspent skill point, synchronously run original HeroLevelUpEvent once per crossed level.
originalHandlerOrder: if Game_Mode!=2 AND currentLevel>20 AND B015<=0: UnitStripHeroLevel(level-20), localLevel=20
X04.strip: Reduce k levels and reset XP=T(resultLevel); no extra level-up event. Typically cross21 then strip1, but a previously qualified level25 that lost B015 crosses26 then strips6. This file fixes XP/level/event behavior, not unrelated learned-skill or attribute rollback semantics.
X04.afterStrip: Abort this award level-loop and discard remaining overflow to prevent 20->21->20 repetition. Preserve original post-strip W019 call.
X04.noContinuousGate: B015 loss alone does not lower an existing level. No new level event at30; direct book level30 guard returns.
X04.xpBelow21: Unqualified level20 may accumulate belowT21; on crossing21 reset toT20. Acquiring B015 later does not restore lostXP.
X04.level30: No further XP accumulation or level event.
